objects.subject: mask_of_madness
objects.reason_zh: 自身获得移速提升，但该增益主要提供攻速，移速属于附带效果。

objects.subject: phase_boots
objects.quote: Gives %phase_movement_speed%%% increased movement speed on melee heroes, and %phase_movement_speed_range%%% on ranged heroes, and lets you move through units and turn more quickly for %phase_duration% seconds.
objects.reason_zh: 主动短时提升自身移速并允许穿过单位，主要用于移动、追击或逃跑。

objects.subject: sange_and_yasha
objects.reason_zh: 装备提供自身常驻移速属性，属于综合属性中的附带加成。

objects.subject: shadow_amulet
objects.quote: Movement speed during the invisibility is reduced by %movement_speed_reduction%%%.
objects.reason_zh: 隐身期间降低移速，材料没有提供移速提升。

objects.subject: sheepstick
objects.quote: The target has a base movement speed of %sheep_movement_speed%
objects.reason_zh: 效果只是设定目标的基础移速，没有说明给予自身或友方移速加成。

objects.subject: shivas_guard
objects.quote: slows their movement by %blast_movement_speed%%% for %blast_debuff_duration% seconds
objects.reason_zh: 只降低敌人的移动速度，不提供自身或友方移速提升。

objects.subject: silver_edge
objects.quote: While invisible, you move %windwalk_movement_speed%%% faster and can move through units.
objects.reason_zh: 隐身期间提升自身移速并允许穿过单位，具有明确的追击和逃跑用途。

objects.subject: smoke_of_deceit
objects.quote: Turns the caster and all allied player-controlled targets in a %application_radius% radius invisible, and grants %bonus_movement_speed%%% bonus movement speed for %duration% seconds.
objects.reason_zh: 为使用者和范围内友方提供隐身及限时移速加成，主要服务于移动和接近目标。

objects.subject: solar_crest
objects.quote: + 25 Movement Speed；When cast on an ally, grants them %target_armor% armor, %target_attack_speed% attack speed, %target_movement_speed%%% movement speed and a %absorb_amount% physical damage barrier.
objects.reason_zh: 装备属性提升自身移速，主动为友方提供移速，且移速属于综合增益的一部分。

objects.subject: swift_blink
objects.quote: After teleportation, you gain %bonus_movement%%% phased movement speed and +%bonus_agi_active% Agility for %duration% seconds.
objects.reason_zh: 闪烁后给予自身限时相位移速提升，主要用于快速移动、追击或脱离。

objects.subject: tranquil_boots
objects.reason_zh: 提供自身常驻移速属性，没有短时追逃加速效果。

objects.subject: travel_boots
objects.reason_zh: 提供自身常驻移速属性，说明中的主动相关效果主要是升级传送。

objects.subject: travel_boots_2
objects.reason_zh: 提供自身常驻移速属性，说明中的主动相关效果主要是升级传送。

objects.subject: wind_waker
objects.reason_zh: 装备属性提升自身移速；旋风可移动的固定速度本身没有写成移速提升。

objects.subject: yasha_and_kaya
objects.reason_zh: 提供自身常驻移速属性，属于多项综合属性中的附带加成。
